meta.modZh: 白门的奇异附魔：苦痛长河：重生
meta.modEn: MarbleGate's Exotic Enchantment: Flowing Agony: Reborn

authors.name: Error1015
authors.role: 所有者 / 移植与维护

categories.zhDesc: 以逝者之名，让装备从你的伤痛、愈合与杀戮中自行修复。
categories.enDesc: In the name of the departed, gear mends itself from your pain, your healing and your slaughter.

categories.zhDesc: 因他人比你更强而燃起的妒意，化作箭矢、荆棘与借刀杀人。
categories.enDesc: Envy lit by those stronger than you, turned into arrows, thorns and turning foes against each other.

categories.zhDesc: 把承受过的每一种折磨，铸成回敬给世界的刀刃。
categories.enDesc: Every torment you have endured, reforged into a blade to answer the world.

categories.zhDesc: 以理智为代价换取压倒性的痛苦输出。
categories.enDesc: Trade your sanity for overwhelming, agonising output.

categories.zhDesc: 村庄、绿宝石与肮脏交易——在黑暗里讨生活的手段。
categories.enDesc: Villages, emeralds and dirty dealings — the tools of surviving in the dark.

categories.zhDesc: 越是濒死，越能榨出身体里最后的那点东西。
categories.enDesc: The closer to death, the more the body surrenders its last reserves.

categories.zhDesc: 把致命伤害转嫁给别人，这是最古老的求生智慧。
categories.enDesc: Pass the fatal blow to someone else — the oldest survival wisdom there is.

categories.zhDesc: 每一次呼吸、每一次治疗，都是一场押上性命的赌博。
categories.enDesc: Every breath and every heal is a gamble staked with your life.

categories.zhDesc: 不该存在的东西寄居在你身上，它保护你，也腐化你。
categories.enDesc: Something that should not exist dwells in you: it shields you, and it rots you.

categories.zhDesc: 恨意是最耐用的燃料，连死亡都能被它拖住。
categories.enDesc: Hatred is the most durable fuel — it can even hold death back.

categories.zhDesc: 把敌人的恶意聚焦、放大，再原样奉还。
categories.enDesc: Focus and magnify your enemies' malice, then return it in kind.

enchantments.zhLore: 红龙莫里尔的最后一个愿望，赋予装备从你的痛苦中获得自我修复的力量。
enchantments.enLore: Morir the Red Dragon's last wish grants your gear the ability to mend itself by absorbing power from your pain.
enchantments.zhEffect: 每当你受到 1 点伤害，你穿戴或拿在手上的拥有该附魔的物品会回复 1-3 点耐久。你死亡后，拥有该附魔的物品会恢复 64 耐久，该效果有 10 分钟冷却时间。
enchantments.enEffect: Whenever you take 1 point of damage, items you are wearing or holding that have this enchantment restore 1-3 points of durability. After you die, items with this enchantment restore 64 durability; this effect has a 10-minute cooldown.

enchantments.zhLore: 红龙莫里尔留下的最后礼物，赋予装备从你的自愈中获得自我修复的力量。
enchantments.enLore: Morir the Red Dragon's last gift grants your gear the ability to mend itself by absorbing power from your relief.
enchantments.zhEffect: 每当你恢复 1 点生命值，你穿戴或拿在手上的拥有该附魔的物品会回复 1-10 点耐久。你死亡后，拥有该附魔的物品会损失 32 耐久。
enchantments.enEffect: Whenever you restore 1 point of health, items you are wearing or holding that have this enchantment restore 1-10 points of durability. After you die, items with this enchantment lose 32 durability.

enchantments.zhLore: 合成人盖登的最后一个愿望，赋予装备从杀戮中获得自我修复的力量。
enchantments.enLore: Guiden's last wish grants your gear the ability to mend itself by slaughtering.
enchantments.zhEffect: 每当你杀死一个生物，你穿戴或拿在手上的拥有该附魔的物品会回复 1-3 点耐久。
enchantments.enEffect: Whenever you kill a creature, items you are wearing or holding that have this enchantment restore 1-3 points of durability.

enchantments.zhLore: 当你的装备即将毁坏，扔掉它，它将会从你的梦境里完整地归来。
enchantments.enLore: When your gear is about to break, throw it out, and it will return from your dream intactly.
enchantments.zhEffect: 当拥有该附魔的物品的耐久度低于10%时，将该物品丢出背包后其会消失，并会在下一次玩家睡醒后以满耐久回到玩家身边。一次只能生效于一件装备。先前扔掉的装备将会重新出现在玩家附近。
enchantments.enEffect: When an item with this enchantment falls below 10% durability, throwing it out of your inventory makes it disappear, and it will return to the player at full durability after the player next wakes from sleep. Only one piece of equipment can be affected at a time. Previously discarded equipment will reappear near the player.

enchantments.zhLore: 因敌人比你更强大而产生的妒意会让你充满力量。
enchantments.enLore: Your envy of enemy who's stronger than you makes you more powerful.
enchantments.zhEffect: 每次进攻时，如果攻击目标与自身生命值存在差距，那么自身将根据相差生命值获得一个对应等级的 10s 残暴妒者 (Envious Being) Buff，每 10 点生命值差距将会提高一级Buff，且高等级Buff会覆盖低等级Buff。
enchantments.enEffect: Each time you attack, if there is a health difference between the target and yourself, you gain a 10s Envious Being buff of a tier corresponding to the health difference; every 10 points of health difference raises the buff by one tier, and a higher-tier buff overrides a lower-tier buff.

enchantments.zhLore: 你的妒意将引爆箭矢。
enchantments.enLore: Your envy will detonate arrow.
enchantments.zhEffect: 箭矢将在3秒延迟后引爆，造成 3/5/7 点伤害，并对目标造成 3/4/5 s“失明 (Blindness)”负面效果与 3/4/5 s 的“缓慢 (Slowness)”负面效果。
enchantments.enEffect: The arrow detonates after a 3-second delay, dealing 3/5/7 points of damage and inflicting Blindness for 3/4/5 s and Slowness for 3/4/5 s on the target.

enchantments.zhLore: 你的妒意将化为荆棘。
enchantments.enLore: Your envy will grow into thorn.
enchantments.zhEffect: 箭矢将对目标造成 5/7/9 秒的 50% 减速效果，在此期间，目标将因疼痛难忍而每隔2.5s停下一次脚步。如果目标是玩家，那么减速效果将变为 20%，停下脚步将变为造成 1 点荆棘伤害。
enchantments.enEffect: The arrow inflicts a 50% slowdown on the target for 5/7/9 seconds; during this time, the target stops in place once every 2.5s from unbearable pain. If the target is a player, the slowdown becomes 20% and the stop in place becomes 1 point of thorns damage.

enchantments.zhLore: 末影人的噩梦。
enchantments.enLore: The nightmare of enderman.
enchantments.zhEffect: 末影人 (Enderman)有 50%/70%/100% 的概率无法成功躲避拥有该附魔的弓射出的箭矢。
enchantments.enEffect: An Enderman has a 50%/70%/100% chance to fail to dodge arrows fired from a bow with this enchantment.

enchantments.zhLore: 对你成功的攻击将令袭击者的同类产生嫉妒。
enchantments.enLore: Makes creature who attacked you an attacking target of its own kind due to envy.
enchantments.zhEffect: 攻击你的生物有会 20%/25%/30%/35%/40% 成为附近同类生物攻击的目标。如果攻击者是玩家，那么TA会有 10%/12%/14%/16%/18% 成为附近所有敌对生物攻击的目标。
enchantments.enEffect: Creatures that attack you have a 20%/25%/30%/35%/40% chance to become the attack target of nearby creatures of the same kind. If the attacker is a player, they have a 10%/12%/14%/16%/18% chance to become the attack target of all nearby hostile creatures.

enchantments.zhLore: 当你身负重伤时，受伤反而会给予你奇异的力量。
enchantments.enLore: When you are severely injured, being hurt grants you mighty power.
enchantments.zhEffect: 当血量低于6/8/10点时，每承受一次伤害，都会增加一层“苦难祈求”增益效果。
enchantments.enEffect: When health is below 6/8/10 points, each time you take damage you gain one stack of the Suffering Prayer buff.

enchantments.zhLore: 受到特定类型的伤害将让你充满喜悦，这份喜悦将带给你力量。
enchantments.enLore: Being hurt by certain source grants you abnormal joy, which brings you power.
enchantments.zhEffect: 每受到1点摔落，挤压，窒息，凋零，火焰与中毒伤害，就会获得 0.5/0.75/1 点“异样喜悦 (Abnormal Joy)”点数。
enchantments.enEffect: For every 1 point of fall, squeeze, suffocation, wither, fire and poison damage taken, you gain 0.5/0.75/1 "Abnormal Joy" point(s).

enchantments.zhLore: 受到特定类型的伤害将让你充满喜悦，这份喜悦将带给你力量。
enchantments.enLore: Being hurt by certain source grants you abnormal joy, which brings you power.
enchantments.zhEffect: 每受到1点来自仙人掌，甜浆果从，投射物的伤害，就会获得 0.5/0.75/1 点“异样喜悦 (Abnormal Joy)”点数。
enchantments.enEffect: For every 1 point of damage taken from cacti, sweet berry bushes and projectiles, you gain 0.5/0.75/1 "Abnormal Joy" point(s).

enchantments.zhLore: 在火焰中受伤将让你极度恐惧，你的这份恐惧将灼伤所有敌人。
enchantments.enLore: Being hurt while you are burning ignites tremendous fear, which burns all enemies.
enchantments.zhEffect: 当你被点燃或者在岩浆中时，受到除火焰与岩浆外的任何伤害，自身都会获得20/15/10s“反胃 (Nausea)”与“缓慢 (Slowness)”负面效果，但周围所有敌对生物与攻击者遭受 200%/250%/300% 该伤害。
enchantments.enEffect: While you are on fire or in lava, taking any damage other than fire and lava damage grants you 20/15/10s of "Nausea" and "Slowness", but all nearby hostile mobs and attackers suffer 200%/250%/300% of that damage.

enchantments.zhLore: 在游泳时受伤将让你极度恐惧，你的这份恐惧将灼伤所有敌人。
enchantments.enLore: Being hurt while you are swimming ignites tremendous fear, which burns all enemies.
enchantments.zhEffect: 当你在游泳时候受到任何伤害，自身都会获得20/15/10s“反胃 (Nausea)”与“失明 (Blindness)”负面效果，但周围所有敌对生物与攻击者遭受 200%/250%/300% 该伤害。
enchantments.enEffect: While you are swimming, taking any damage grants you 20/15/10s of "Nausea" and "Blindness", but all nearby hostile mobs and attackers suffer 200%/250%/300% of that damage.

enchantments.zhLore: 受到特定类型的伤害将让你充满喜悦，这份喜悦将带给你力量。
enchantments.enLore: Being hurt by certain source grants you abnormal joy, which brings you power.
enchantments.zhEffect: 每受到1点魔法，雷击，爆炸伤害，就会获得 0.5/0.75/1 点“异样喜悦 (Abnormal Joy)”点数。
enchantments.enEffect: For every 1 point of magic, lightning and explosion damage taken, you gain 0.5/0.75/1 "Abnormal Joy" point(s).

enchantments.zhLore: 你攻击的目标将承受他人的痛苦。
enchantments.enLore: Victim takes other creatures' pain.
enchantments.zhEffect: 对被攻击目标施加 8/9/10s 对应等级的“苦痛共鸣 (Agony Resonance)”负面效果。
enchantments.enEffect: Inflicts 8/9/10s of "Agony Resonance" of the corresponding level on the attacked target.

enchantments.zhLore: 这是什么旋律？
enchantments.enLore: What is that melody?
enchantments.zhEffect: 弓箭攻击力降低至默认的10%，对被攻击目标施加 2/4/6/8/10s 对应等级的“听我歌唱 (Listen to Me Singing)”负面效果。同时你也将受到 2/4/6/8/10s 的80%减速效果。
enchantments.enEffect: Bow attack damage is reduced to 10% of the default value. Inflicts 2/4/6/8/10s of "Listen to Me Singing" of the corresponding level on the attacked target. At the same time, you also suffer an 80% slowness effect for 2/4/6/8/10s.

enchantments.zhLore: 让你的敌人放弃弃弃弃弃思考考考考考。
enchantments.enLore: Stttttops your enemy from thiiiinking.
enchantments.zhEffect: 剑攻击力降低至默认的10%，你攻击的任何生物将在3/5/7s内几乎无法正常跟随任何目标，且在此期间每0.5s将受到1次雷击，每次雷击将造成2-4点无视护甲的伤害。
enchantments.enEffect: Sword attack damage is reduced to 10% of the default value. Any creature you attack will be almost unable to follow any target normally for 3/5/7s, and during this period it will be struck by lightning once every 0.5s; each lightning strike deals 2-4 points of damage that ignores armor.

enchantments.zhLore: 让你的敌人放弃思考。
enchantments.enLore: Stops your enemy from thinking.
enchantments.zhEffect: 剑攻击力降低至默认的10%，你攻击的任何生物将在3/5/7s内几乎无法正常跟随任何目标，且在此期间每1s受到5-8点的魔法伤害。
enchantments.enEffect: Sword attack damage is reduced to 10% of the default value. Any creature you attack will be almost unable to follow any target normally for 3/5/7s, and during this period it takes 5-8 points of magic damage every 1s.

enchantments.zhLore: 切开西瓜的动作将对敌人造成巨额魔法伤害。
enchantments.enLore: All nearby monsters will receive heavy magic damage when you destroy a watermelon.
enchantments.zhEffect:
当你破坏西瓜时，周围所有的怪物都将承受该工具攻击力 200%-300% 的伤害。如果你在夜晚触发附魔效果，造成伤害将提升至 400%-600% 倍。同时工具失去5点耐久。
联动附魔：【精准采集】伤害降低为工具攻击力伤害的 50% ，但有额外 2.5% 的几率掉落头颅，该几率受到【时运】影响。【时运】掉落物将增加。【耐久】工具失去耐久调整为 4/4/3点。
该附魔在Backport 1.15.2版本中被移除。
enchantments.enEffect:
When you break a melon, all nearby monsters will suffer 200%-300% of the tool's attack damage. If you trigger the enchantment effect at night, the damage dealt will be increased to 400%-600% times. At the same time, the tool loses 5 points of durability.
Synergy: [Silk Touch] damage is reduced to 50% of the tool's attack damage, but there is an additional 2.5% chance to drop a head, and this chance is affected by [Fortune]. [Fortune] drops will be increased. [Unbreaking] the tool's durability loss is adjusted to 4/4/3 points.
This enchantment was removed in the Backport 1.15.2 version.

enchantments.zhLore: 当你替村民清除异变的同类时，周围的村民会提升对你的好感度。
enchantments.enLore: When you eliminate zombie villager or witch, surrounding villagers will be appreciated.
enchantments.zhEffect: 当你杀死女巫和僵尸村民时，周围村民对你的好感度会上升1点。
enchantments.enEffect: When you kill witches and zombie villagers, nearby villagers' favor toward you increases by 1 point.

enchantments.zhLore: 你能用村民的血肉来清洗这一件物品。
enchantments.enLore: Cleanses your gear in villager's flesh and blood.
enchantments.zhEffect: 每当你使用该物品杀死村民时，该物品的修复惩罚将归零，同时回复10点耐久。
enchantments.enEffect: Whenever you use this item to kill a villager, this item's repair penalty is reset to zero and 10 points of durability are restored.

enchantments.zhLore: 杀死村民一定概率掠夺绿宝石与金锭。
enchantments.enLore: You can loot emerald and gold when you kill villagers.
enchantments.zhEffect: 杀死村民有 10% * 总附魔等级 的概率会掉落 1 绿宝石与 2% * 总附魔等级 的概率会掉落 1 金锭，而“村庄英雄”增益效果将不对你生效。
enchantments.enEffect: Killing a villager has a 10% * total enchantment level chance to drop 1 emerald and a 2% * total enchantment level chance to drop 1 gold ingot, and the "Hero of the Village" buff will no longer apply to you.

enchantments.zhLore: 为你在傍晚提供村庄英雄效果。
enchantments.enLore: Gives you the buff "Hero of the Village" at dusk.
enchantments.zhEffect: 使你在傍晚时刻拥有随即等级且不断刷新的“村庄英雄 ”增益效果。
enchantments.enEffect: Grants you a random-level, constantly refreshing "Hero of the Village " buff in the evening.

enchantments.zhLore: 从空中跃下来偷取村民的物品。
enchantments.enLore: Enables you to steal items from a village when landing nearby.
enchantments.zhEffect: 当你落地在村民边上时，有一定概率随机从他交易列表里偷取0-3项物品，但最多不能超过交易列表条目数量的一半。该附魔会进行三次偷窃判定，每次判定会偷取一件物品，落地高度越高概率越大，从5格高位置跳下的成功率分别为为30%|15%|5%，从15格高位置跳下的成功率分别为80%|40%|20%。但同样的，你有最低30%，最高80%概率对村民造成1-6点伤害（伤害概率随落地高度变化）。该附魔效果如果生效，每次成功的偷盗将损耗鞋子耐久30点。
enchantments.enEffect: When you land next to a villager, there is a certain chance to randomly steal 0-3 items from his trade list, but this can never exceed half the number of entries in the trade list. This enchantment performs three steal checks, each stealing one item; the higher the landing height, the greater the chance. When jumping down from a height of 5 blocks, the success rates are 30%|15%|5% respectively; when jumping down from a height of 15 blocks, the success rates are 80%|40%|20% respectively. Likewise, however, you have a minimum 30% and maximum 80% chance to deal 1-6 points of damage to the villager (the damage chance varies with landing height). If this enchantment effect takes place, each successful theft costs 30 points of boot durability.

enchantments.zhLore: 你能从挖掘的石头里分辨出隐藏的矿物。
enchantments.enLore: You can recognize hidden ores between stones.
enchantments.zhEffect:
>=1.18.2;
附魔效果：挖掘石头与深板岩有1%的概率掉落煤炭，等级Ⅱ附加0.5%概率掉落粗铁与粗铜，等级Ⅲ附加0.1%概率掉落粗金与0.2%概率掉落红石，等级Ⅳ附加0.1%概率掉落青金石，等级Ⅴ附加0.1%概率掉落钻石与绿宝石。
联动附魔：【精准采集 (Silk Touch)】掉落的矿石变为矿石块【时运 (Fortune)】掉落的矿石数量有50%的概率根据时运等级翻倍
=1.17.1;
附魔效果：挖掘石头与深板岩有1%的概率掉落煤炭，等级Ⅱ附加0.5%概率掉落粗铁与粗铜，等级Ⅲ附加0.1%概率掉落粗金与0.2%概率掉落红石，等级Ⅳ附加0.1%概率掉落青金石，等级Ⅴ附加0.1%概率掉落钻石与绿宝石。
联动附魔：【精准采集 (Silk Touch)】掉落的矿石变为矿石块【时运 (Fortune)】掉落的矿石数量有50%的概率翻倍
<=1.16.5:
附魔效果：挖掘石头有1%的概率掉落煤炭，等级Ⅱ附加0.5%概率掉落铁矿石，等级Ⅲ附加0.1%概率掉落金矿石与0.2%概率掉落红石，等级Ⅳ附加0.1%概率掉落青金石，等级Ⅴ附加0.1%概率掉落钻石与绿宝石。
联动附魔：【精准采集 (Silk Touch)】掉落的矿石变为矿石块【时运 (Fortune)】掉落的矿石数量有50%的概率翻倍
enchantments.enEffect:
>=1.18.2:
Effect: Mining stone and deepslate has a 1% chance to drop coal; level II adds a 0.5% chance to drop raw iron and raw copper; level III adds a 0.1% chance to drop raw gold and a 0.2% chance to drop redstone; level IV adds a 0.1% chance to drop lapis lazuli; level V adds a 0.1% chance to drop diamonds and emeralds.
Synergy: [Silk Touch] the dropped ore becomes an ore block; [Fortune] the amount of ore dropped has a 50% chance to be doubled according to the Fortune level
=1.17.1:
Effect: Mining stone and deepslate has a 1% chance to drop coal; level II adds a 0.5% chance to drop raw iron and raw copper; level III adds a 0.1% chance to drop raw gold and a 0.2% chance to drop redstone; level IV adds a 0.1% chance to drop lapis lazuli; level V adds a 0.1% chance to drop diamonds and emeralds.
Synergy: [Silk Touch] the dropped ore becomes an ore block; [Fortune] the amount of ore dropped has a 50% chance to be doubled
<=1.16.5:
Effect: Mining stone has a 1% chance to drop coal; level II adds a 0.5% chance to drop iron ore; level III adds a 0.1% chance to drop gold ore and a 0.2% chance to drop redstone; level IV adds a 0.1% chance to drop lapis lazuli; level V adds a 0.1% chance to drop diamonds and emeralds.
Synergy: [Silk Touch] the dropped ore becomes an ore block; [Fortune] the amount of ore dropped has a 50% chance to be doubled

enchantments.zhLore: 你可以通过铁砧合并同一大类的物品。
enchantments.enLore: You can merge 2 gear of same category on anvil.
enchantments.zhEffect: 击杀生物后，其穿着的每件可掉落装备都将过一次 15%/25%/35% 的掉落判定。
enchantments.enEffect: After killing a mob, each piece of droppable equipment it is wearing goes through a 15%/25%/35% drop check.

enchantments.zhLore: 在身受重伤时提升你的速度。不要尝试剧烈运动。
enchantments.enLore: When you are severely injured, your movement speed increases gradually. Do not do any strenuous exercise.
enchantments.zhEffect: 血量降低至 4/5/6 点以下时移动速度会逐步提升，最高提升至250%。奔跑，游泳和飞行会导致移动速度加成被清除。
enchantments.enEffect: When health drops below 4/5/6 points, movement speed gradually increases, up to 250%. Running, swimming and flying will clear the movement speed bonus.

enchantments.zhLore: 在你受到攻击时取消自身漂浮效果，同时赋予你击退抗性。
enchantments.enLore: Removes the Levitation effect on you and weakens the knockback effect when you're attacked.
enchantments.zhEffect: 当你受到攻击时，你身上“飘浮 (Levitation)”效果会被自动取消，对你的击退效果恒定削弱15%/30%。
enchantments.enEffect: When you take an attack, the "Levitation" effect on you is automatically cancelled, and knockback against you is constantly reduced by 15%/30%.

enchantments.zhLore: 在你受到攻击时取消自身缓慢效果并获得速度提升。
enchantments.enLore: Removes the Slowness effect on you and increases your speed when you're attacked.
enchantments.zhEffect: 当你受到攻击时，你身上缓慢 (Slowness)效果会被自动取消，在接下来10s内你的移动速度将增加15%/30% 。
enchantments.enEffect: When you take an attack, the Slowness effect on you is automatically cancelled, and over the next 10s your movement speed increases by 15%/30% .

enchantments.zhLore: 给予你在濒死时逃脱的机会。
enchantments.enLore: Grants you the chance to escape from death.
enchantments.zhEffect: 当你受到伤害且受到伤害前的血量不高于4点（）时，该次伤害将被回避，同时你将被向头顶弹射出去，并在短时间内取得方向控制权。该效果触发时，你将在接下来10秒内对摔落，挤压与窒息伤害免疫。该效果有10秒冷却时间。
enchantments.enEffect: When you take damage and your health before taking that damage is not higher than 4 points, that instance of damage is avoided, and you are launched upward above your head, gaining directional control for a short time. When this effect triggers, you become immune to fall, crush and suffocation damage for the next 10 seconds. This effect has a 10 second cooldown.

enchantments.zhLore: 当你身受重伤时，每次受伤都将给予你临时血量。
enchantments.enLore: When you are severely injured, be hurt grants you temporary health.
enchantments.zhEffect: 当你生命值低于6/7/8点时，你每受到一次伤害，都会获得1点临时生命值。临时生命值上限为6/7/8。
enchantments.enEffect: When your health is below 6/7/8 points, each time you take damage you gain 1 point of temporary health. The temporary health cap is 6/7/8.

enchantments.zhLore: 你受到的单次大额伤害将被转移至某非敌对生物。
enchantments.enLore: You won't take heavy damage and instead, a passive or neutral mob nearby will take this damage.
enchantments.zhEffect: 当你受到不小于 8/7/6 点的伤害时，你不会承受该伤害，你附近的某一非敌对生物会替你承受该伤害。如果附近没有可以承受伤害的目标，那么所受到的伤害将被减免10%/15%/20%，而受到的爆炸伤害将被减免 20%/30%/40%。如果伤害来源是玩家，那么该附魔将只提供 10%/15%/20% 伤害减免。
enchantments.enEffect: When you take damage of no less than 8/7/6 points, you do not suffer that damage; a nearby non-hostile creature suffers it in your place. If there is no target nearby that can take the damage, the damage you take is reduced by 10%/15%/20%, and explosion damage you take is reduced by 20%/30%/40%. If the damage source is a player, this enchantment only provides 10%/15%/20% damage reduction.

enchantments.zhLore: 你受到的单次大额伤害将被转移至某敌对生物。
enchantments.enLore: You won't take heavy damage and instead, a hostile mob nearby will take this damage.
enchantments.zhEffect: 当你受到不小于 8/7/6 点的伤害时，你不会承受该伤害，你附近的某一敌对生物会替你承受该伤害。如果附近没有可以承受伤害的目标，那么所受到的伤害将被减免 10%/15%/20%，而受到的爆炸伤害将被减免 20%/30%/40%。如果伤害来源是玩家，那么该附魔将只提供 10%/15%/20% 伤害减免。
enchantments.enEffect: When you take damage of no less than 8/7/6 points, you do not suffer that damage; a nearby hostile creature suffers it in your place. If there is no target nearby that can take the damage, the damage you take is reduced by 10%/15%/20%, and explosion damage you take is reduced by 20%/30%/40%. If the damage source is a player, this enchantment only provides 10%/15%/20% damage reduction.

enchantments.zhLore: 你受到的单次巨额伤害将被转移至周围所有生物。
enchantments.enLore: You won't take extremely heavy damage and instead, all mobs nearby will take this damage together.
enchantments.zhEffect: 当你受到不小于 12/11/10 点的伤害时，你不会承受该伤害，你附近的所有非玩家生物会替你平均分摊该伤害。如果附近没有可以承受伤害的目标，那么你所受到的伤害将被减免 20%/25%/30%，而受到的爆炸伤害将被减免 40%/50%/60%。 如果伤害来源是玩家，那么该附魔将只提供 20%/25%/30% 伤害减免。
enchantments.enEffect: When you take damage of no less than 12/11/10 points, you do not suffer that damage; all nearby non-player creatures share that damage evenly in your place. If there is no target nearby that can take the damage, the damage you take is reduced by 20%/25%/30%, and explosion damage you take is reduced by 40%/50%/60%. If the damage source is a player, this enchantment only provides 20%/25%/30% damage reduction.

enchantments.zhLore: 你的攻击将对目标施加负面效果。
enchantments.enLore: Your attack applies random debuff on victim.
enchantments.zhEffect: 你的每次攻击必定附加以下负面效果中的1/2种：中毒 (Poison)，凋零 (Wither)，虚弱 (Weakness)，点燃，缓慢 (Slowness)。
enchantments.enEffect: Each of your attacks is guaranteed to apply 1/2 of the following negative effects: Poison, Wither, Weakness, Ignition, Slowness.

enchantments.enName: An Enchanted Golden Apple A Day
enchantments.zhLore: 穿越维度将赋予你附魔金苹果的增益。
enchantments.enLore: You will get the buffs that an enchanted golden apple can bring every time you cross the dimension.
enchantments.zhEffect: 每有一件护甲上有此附魔，你每次穿越维度都将获得附魔金苹果 (Enchanted Golden Apple)能带来的增益效果中的一种。该效果有 15 分钟的冷却时间。
enchantments.enEffect: For each piece of armor that has this enchantment, each time you travel across dimensions you gain one of the beneficial effects that an Enchanted Golden Apple can provide. This effect has a 15 minute cooldown.

enchantments.zhLore: 你的死亡将由其他事物替你承担。
enchantments.enLore: Your death will be taken by things unknown.
enchantments.zhEffect:
除非玩家掉落虚空死亡，否则在玩家受到致命伤害时，有25%的概率玩家的2点（）生命值将和2点（）饥饿值+2点（）饱和度互换，有25%的概率玩家的2点（）生命值将和氧气值互换，有25%的概率玩家将用经验值填满2点（）生命值（30经验值可填充1点（）生命值），有25%的概率玩家的牺牲这一项附魔来换取完全康复。

如果玩家无法支付代价，那你必将损失该附魔来换取完全康复。
enchantments.enEffect:
Unless the player dies by falling into the void, when the player takes fatal damage there is a 25% chance that 2 points of the player's health will be swapped with 2 points of hunger + 2 points of saturation, a 25% chance that 2 points of the player's health will be swapped with oxygen, a 25% chance that the player will use experience points to fill 2 points of health (30 experience points can fill 1 point of health), and a 25% chance that the player will sacrifice this enchantment in exchange for a full recovery.

If the player cannot pay the cost, then you will inevitably lose this enchantment in exchange for a full recovery.

enchantments.zhLore: 重复攻击某种生物给予攻击力加成。
enchantments.enLore: Increases your attack damage when you attack one kind of creatures repeatedly.
enchantments.zhEffect: 重复攻击某种生物，武器攻击力随机提高 3-7/7-11/11-15 点。攻击不同的生物攻击力将会重置。
enchantments.enEffect: By repeatedly attacking a certain creature, weapon attack power is randomly increased by 3-7/7-11/11-15 points. Attacking a different creature will reset the attack power.

enchantments.zhLore: 你的自愈能力有了自己的想法。也许是值得的？
enchantments.enLore: Your recovery ability has its own thoughts now. Is it really worthy?
enchantments.zhEffect: 当你生命值将要恢复时，你有33%的概率不会获得该恢复效果，33%的概率获得2倍恢复效果，24%的概率获得3倍恢复效果，5%的概率效果恢复效果保持不变，1%的概率给你10s“力量 (Strength)”增益效果，1%的概率给你10s“速度 (Speed)”增益效果，1%的概率给你10s“生命恢复 (Regeneration)”增益效果，1%的概率给你10s“隐身 (Invisibility)”增益效果，1%的概率恢复效果将转变为伤害。护甲上每多一级该附魔，该附魔效果将增强10%。
enchantments.enEffect: When your health is about to be restored, there is a 33% chance you will not gain that restoration effect, a 33% chance of gaining 2x the restoration effect, a 24% chance of gaining 3x the restoration effect, a 5% chance that the restoration effect remains unchanged, a 1% chance of giving you a 10s "Strength" buff, a 1% chance of giving you a 10s "Speed" buff, a 1% chance of giving you a 10s "Regeneration" buff, a 1% chance of giving you a 10s "Invisibility" buff, and a 1% chance that the restoration effect will be converted into damage. For each additional level of this enchantment on the armor, this enchantment's effect is increased by 10%.

enchantments.zhLore: 赋予你对于黑暗的适应性。
enchantments.enLore: Grants you the adaptation of darkness.
enchantments.zhEffect: 在亮度低于5的位置你将获得夜视效果，在亮度高于5的位置你将免疫失明效果。
enchantments.enEffect: In locations with a light level below 5, you gain Night Vision; in locations with a light level above 5, you are immune to Blindness.

enchantments.zhLore: 获得状态效果将为你带来临时的生命值上限提升。
enchantments.enLore: Obtaining status effect temporarily brings you more health point.
enchantments.zhEffect: 你每获得一种效果或已有效果被刷新，便会获得 1/2/3 点生命值上限。生命值上限提升持续 1 分钟，上限为30点。
enchantments.enEffect: Each time you gain an effect or an existing effect is refreshed, you gain 1/2/3 points of maximum health. The maximum health increase lasts 1 minute, up to a maximum of 30 points.

enchantments.zhLore: 你获得的增益效果持续时间将增加一倍。
enchantments.enLore: Duration of every buff you obtain will be extended by 100%.
enchantments.zhEffect:
你获得的增益效果持续时间将增加100%。
联动附魔：【混乱原体】如果你装备上拥有混乱原体附魔，那么你获得的增益状态持续时间再次增加100%，你拥有的所有可被牛奶治愈的负面效果将在获得增益效果时被移除。
enchantments.enEffect:
The duration of beneficial effects you gain is increased by 100%.
Synergy: [Prototype Chaotic] If you have the Prototype Chaotic enchantment equipped, the duration of beneficial effects you gain is increased by another 100%, and all negative effects you have that can be cured by milk are removed when you gain a beneficial effect.

enchantments.zhLore: 亡灵生物对你的伤害将被削弱。
enchantments.enLore: Reduces damage from undead creatures.
enchantments.zhEffect: 来自常见亡灵类生物的攻击将削弱 60%/70%/80%/90%/100%，来自其他亡灵生物的攻击将被削弱 10%/20%/30%/40%/50%，来自凋零的伤害将被削弱 0%/5%/10%/15%/20%。但亡灵类生物的攻击会有 5%/4%/3%/2%/1% 几率触发“亡灵诅咒 (Curse of Undead)”负面效果。
enchantments.enEffect: Attacks from common undead creatures are reduced by 60%/70%/80%/90%/100%, attacks from other undead creatures are reduced by 10%/20%/30%/40%/50%, and damage from the Wither is reduced by 0%/5%/10%/15%/20%. However, attacks from undead creatures have a 5%/4%/3%/2%/1% chance to trigger the “Curse of Undead” negative effect.

enchantments.zhLore: 寄生的特殊真菌会为你提供保护。
enchantments.enLore: This special fungal offers you special protection.
enchantments.zhEffect: 你免疫中毒 (Poison)效果，受到的跌落伤害降低10%/15%/20%，受到的爆炸伤害降低10%/15%/20%，受到的火焰伤害降低10%/15%/20%。当你被攻击时，该附魔将朝周围无差别释放6s“光蚀真菌感染 (Lightburn Fungal Infection)”负面效果，感染负面效果成功率为25%/37.5%/50%。
enchantments.enEffect: You are immune to Poison, fall damage taken is reduced by 10%/15%/20%, explosion damage taken is reduced by 10%/15%/20%, and fire damage taken is reduced by 10%/15%/20%. When you are attacked, this enchantment indiscriminately releases the 6s “Lightburn Fungal Infection” negative effect around you, with a 25%/37.5%/50% chance to successfully inflict the negative effect.

enchantments.zhLore: 他人死亡，你也死亡。
enchantments.enLore: Kills you as soon as any nearby player is dead.
enchantments.zhEffect: 如果你周围有其他玩家死亡，你将会和他一同死去。
enchantments.enEffect: If another player dies near you, you will die along with them.

enchantments.zhLore: 学习罪孽将让你身躯更加脆弱，但也让你能更好地分析经验。
enchantments.enLore: Learning and researching original sin makes your body more fragile, but it also makes you more experienced in analyzing experience.
enchantments.zhEffect: 你受到的所有负面效果都将延长 100%/90%/80% 持续时间，受到的伤害将增加 100%/90%/80%，上限为10点，但你获取的经验值将提升 50%/65%/80%。
enchantments.enEffect: The duration of all negative effects you receive is extended by 100%/90%/80%, damage taken is increased by 100%/90%/80%, up to a maximum of 10 points, but experience you gain is increased by 50%/65%/80%.

enchantments.zhLore: 罪孽的侵蚀让你失去了部分力量，但也让你能更好地分析经验。
enchantments.enLore: Erosion of original sin extracts power from you, but it also makes you more experienced in analyzing experience.
enchantments.zhEffect: 你造成的伤害降低 4/3/2 点，但你获取的经验值将提升 10%/15%/20%。
enchantments.enEffect: Damage you deal is reduced by 4/3/2 points, but experience you gain is increased by 10%/15%/20%.

enchantments.zhLore: 还击攻击者会让你攻击力短暂提升。
enchantments.enLore: Grants you power if you attack the creature who has just attacked you
enchantments.zhEffect: 攻击刚攻击过你的怪物，你的伤害将在10秒内提升 2/4/6 点，该附魔“攻击”判定时间为 1.2/1.4/1.6s。
enchantments.enEffect: Attacking a monster that has just attacked you increases your damage by 2/4/6 points for 10 seconds; this enchantment's “attack” detection window is 1.2/1.4/1.6s.

enchantments.zhLore: 你会被自己的死亡激怒，复活后一段时间内属性提升。
enchantments.enLore: You will be irritated by your death and be more powerful for a short period of time after you respawn.
enchantments.zhEffect: 在你复活后的40秒内你的移动速度提升8.33%，攻击伤害将提升25%，攻击速度将提升8.33%。你护甲上的累计附魔等级高1级，该附魔效果提升100%。
enchantments.enEffect: For 40 seconds after you respawn, your movement speed is increased by 8.33%, attack damage is increased by 25%, and attack speed is increased by 8.33%. For every 1 level by which your armor's accumulated enchantment level is higher, this enchantment's effect is increased by 100%.

enchantments.zhLore: 你会被承受的负面效果激怒，攻击力提升。
enchantments.enLore: Debuffs applied on you irritates you, which increases your attack damage.
enchantments.zhEffect: 你身上每有一种负面效果（包括着火），你的攻击力便会提升 1/2/3/4/5 点。
enchantments.enEffect: For each negative effect on you (including being on fire), your attack damage is increased by 1/2/3/4/5 points.

enchantments.zhLore: 一个代价和三次逃脱死亡的机会。
enchantments.enLore: One cost and three opportunities of escaping from death.
enchantments.zhEffect: 当你即将死亡时，你会回复4/7/10点生命值，并获得“极端憎恨Ⅰ”负面效果。当你身上存在“极端憎恨 Ⅰ”负面效果同时即将死亡时，你会回复3/5/7点生命值，并获得“极端憎恨 Ⅱ”负面效果。当你身上存在“极端憎恨 Ⅱ”负面效果同时即将死亡时，你会回复2/3/5点生命值，并获得“极端憎恨 Ⅲ”负面效果。当你身上存在“极端憎恨 Ⅲ”负面效果时，该附魔将失效。
enchantments.enEffect: When you are about to die, you restore 4/7/10 points of health and gain the "Extreme Hatred I" negative effect. When you have the "Extreme Hatred I" negative effect and are about to die, you restore 3/5/7 points of health and gain the "Extreme Hatred II" negative effect. When you have the "Extreme Hatred II" negative effect and are about to die, you restore 2/3/5 points of health and gain the "Extreme Hatred III" negative effect. When you have the "Extreme Hatred III" negative effect, this enchantment becomes ineffective.

enchantments.zhLore: 你对攻击者的怨恨将让死亡豁免你。
enchantments.enLore: Your hatred towards attacker will make you exempt from death.
enchantments.zhEffect: 只要刚攻击过你的怪物在你身边，你就永远不会死亡。该附魔“被攻击”判定时间为5s/7.5s/10s。
enchantments.enEffect: As long as a mob that has just attacked you is near you, you will never die. This enchantment's "attacked" detection time is 5s/7.5s/10s.

enchantments.zhLore: 攻击你的生物将被施以仇恨诅咒。
enchantments.enLore: Applies "Cursed Hatred" to the creatures attacking you.
enchantments.zhEffect: 任何攻击你的生物都会获得 9s“仇恨诅咒 (Cursed Hatred)”负面效果，负面效果强度将随附魔等级变化。
enchantments.enEffect: Any creature that attacks you gains the 9s "Cursed Hatred" negative effect, and the strength of the negative effect varies with the enchantment level.

enchantments.zhLore: 攻击你的生物将被施以憎恶诅咒。
enchantments.enLore: Applies "Cursed Antipathy" to the creatures attacking you.
enchantments.zhEffect:
>=1.18 附魔效果：任何攻击你的生物会获得 10s “憎恶诅咒 (Cursed Antipathy)”负面效果，负面效果强度将随附魔等级变化。如果攻击者是玩家，那么他将会获得 10s“ 憎恶诅咒 (Cursed Antipathy) Ⅰ”负面效果和 10s [缓慢 (Slowness)]效果。

<=1.17.1 附魔效果：你能感知到附近的怪物，任何攻击你的生物会获得 10s “憎恶诅咒 (Cursed Antipathy)”负面效果，负面效果强度将随附魔等级变化。如果攻击者是玩家，那么他将会获得 10s“ 憎恶诅咒 (Cursed Antipathy) Ⅰ”负面效果和 10s [缓慢 (Slowness)]效果。
enchantments.enEffect:
>=1.18:
Any creature that attacks you gains the 10s "Cursed Antipathy" negative effect, and the strength of the negative effect varies with the enchantment level. If the attacker is a player, they will gain the 10s "Cursed Antipathy I" negative effect and the 10s [Slowness] effect.

<=1.17.1:
You can sense nearby mobs. Any creature that attacks you gains the 10s "Cursed Antipathy" negative effect, and the strength of the negative effect varies with the enchantment level. If the attacker is a player, they will gain the 10s "Cursed Antipathy I" negative effect and the 10s [Slowness] effect.

enchantments.zhLore: 击飞攻击者。
enchantments.enLore: Knockbacks attacker.
enchantments.zhEffect: 任何攻击你的生物将会被击飞，击飞方向等于你看向的方向，击飞力度为 0.4 * 附魔等级。
enchantments.enEffect: Any creature that attacks you will be knocked back; the knockback direction equals the direction you are looking, and the knockback force is 0.4 * enchantment level.

enchantments.zhLore: 攻击者将向同类传播负面效果。
enchantments.enLore: Spreads random debuff from a attacker to surrounding creatures of the same type once you're attacked.
enchantments.zhEffect: 每当你有一件护甲上有此附魔，你每次受到攻击时，攻击者会将携带的随机一种负面效果传播给周围的同类型生物。如果攻击者是玩家，那么他将会受到“10 x 携带该附魔装备数量”时长的“ 仇恨诅咒 Ⅲ”负面效果。
enchantments.enEffect: For each piece of armor you have with this enchantment, whenever you take a hit, the attacker will spread one random negative effect they are carrying to nearby creatures of the same type. If the attacker is a player, they will receive the "Cursed Hatred III" negative effect for a duration of "10 x number of equipped items with this enchantment".

enchantments.zhLore: 高亮你的敌人。
enchantments.enLore: Highlights hostiles.
enchantments.zhEffect: 大部分以你为目标的怪物+将会被高亮标记，罕有例外。
enchantments.enEffect: Most mobs that target you will be highlighted, with rare exceptions.

enchantments.zhLore: 不以你为首要目标的怪物将受到更多的伤害。
enchantments.enLore: Monsters who do not choose you as priority will receive more damage from you.
enchantments.zhEffect: 攻击不以你为首要攻击目标的怪物造成伤害提升 2/3/4 点，攻击以你为首要攻击目标的怪物将施加 5s 的 10%/20%/30% 减速效果。
enchantments.enEffect: Attacks on mobs that do not have you as their primary target deal 2/3/4 more damage, and attacks on mobs that have you as their primary target apply a 5s 10%/20%/30% slowing effect.

effects.zhDesc: 在受到攻击时，将额外受到仇恨伤害。
effects.enDesc: Greatly strengthens the damage inflicted on one.

effects.zhDesc: 承受无视护甲的憎恶伤害。
effects.enDesc: Causes antipathy damage which ignores armor to target.

effects.zhDesc: 持续损耗饥饿值的同时巨幅增加输出伤害。
effects.enDesc: Tremendously increases attack damage but consumes more hunger points at pretty fast rate. Lasts until you kill a creature.

effects.zhDesc: 为附近所有生物施加“被共鸣（苦痛共鸣）”效果。
effects.enDesc: Imposes the status effect "Been Resonated" on all the nearby mobs.

effects.zhDesc: 每当你承受一次伤害，附近拥有“被共鸣（苦痛共鸣）”负面效果的生物会承受/共鸣伤害。
effects.enDesc: Causes damage as you took to all the nearby creatures who are in the debuff "Agony Resonance".

effects.zhDesc: 你的攻击力将下降。但是你受到攻击后，攻击者会受到伤害。血量高于12点后，该Buff将直接消失。
effects.enDesc: Decreases your attack damage and instead gives the attacker a certain damage. This buff will vanish once your hearts are higher than 12.

effects.zhDesc: 受害者将被反复强制提起再朝着空气墙砸下。
effects.enDesc: The victim will be repeatedly forcibly lifted and then smashed towards the ground.

effects.zhDesc: 你会变得和僵尸一样在太阳下燃烧！因此你必须戴头盔来遮挡阳光。火焰伤害将提高 1 倍，且火焰伤害会导致头盔损坏。喝牛奶无法治愈该负面效果，吃附魔金苹果或死亡方可治愈该负面效果。该状态下吃腐肉将恢复 1 点生命值并给予 3s 力量效果。
effects.enDesc: You burn like a zombie under daylight! A helmet is necessary to block the damage. Largely increases the damage of fire and enables fire to cause damage on helmets. Rather than milk, the debuff can only be removed by enchanted golden apples or death. No more negative effects of hunger under this debuff and you can restore 1 hearts and obtain 3 seconds of buff "Strength Ⅰ" by eating rotten meat.

effects.zhDesc: 受到光蚀真菌感染伤害。拥有光蚀真菌寄生附魔的玩家将免疫该负面效果。
effects.enDesc: Causes lightburn fungal infection damage. Players with the enchantment "Lightburn Fungal Parasitic" are free from this effect.

markerEffects.zhDesc: 模组内部用于承载附魔状态的一类隐藏效果，玩家在游戏内只会看到该统一名称。它们不直接造成伤害，仅作为附魔逻辑的开关与计时器使用。
markerEffects.enDesc: A family of hidden internal effects that carry the enchantment state. In game they all share this single name. They deal no damage on their own and merely act as switches and timers for enchantment logic.

zhNotes: 修复了部分配置文件的修改会被覆盖的问题。
enNotes: Fixed an issue where changes to some configuration files would be overwritten.

zhNotes: 1. 添加纸脑附魔效果对实体造成伤害的百分比数值配置；

2. 优化了配置文件的样式，把原有配置文件细分成：
    是否可交易；
    是否可以被发现；
    是否可以通过附魔台获取；
    是否为宝藏附魔
enNotes: 1. Added a percentage value config for the damage the Paper Brain enchantment effect deals to entities;

zhNotes: 1. 修复了混乱原体附魔提供的状态效果被当做debuff清除的问题；
2. 解决了终端中日志刷屏的问题。
enNotes: 1. Fixed an issue where the status effect granted by the Prototype Chaotic enchantment was removed as a debuff;
2. Resolved the log spam in the terminal.

zhNotes: 2. 为一部分附魔和状态效果添加了配置文件
注意：部分配置为原数值的倍数关系，如果你想削弱一个附魔，你可以配置成0.5，则实际游戏中的数值为原来的一半
enNotes: 1. Fixed the crash bug with Perceived Malice
2. Added configuration files for some enchantments and status effects
Note: some configs are multipliers of the original values. If you want to weaken an enchantment, you can set it to 0.5, and the actual value in game will be half of the original

zhNotes: 1. 添加了专属的创造模式物品栏。
2. 现在开始需要Forge47.1.3的环境运行。
4. 注册了一个Logo物品，用作创造模式物品栏的图标
enNotes: 1. Added a dedicated creative mode inventory tab.
2. The mod now requires a Forge 47.1.3 environment to run.
4. Registered a Logo item to serve as the icon of the creative mode inventory tab

zhNotes: 修复了运行服务器出现报错的问题。
enNotes: Fixed the error that occurred when running a server.
In truth it was not actually fixed (

zhNotes: 修复了部分已知的问题。

gameSetting.zhDesc:
点数上限：100。

能力效果：每次进行攻击，将消耗1点“异样喜悦”额外造成2点无视护甲的伤害，最高消耗5点。当消耗5点“异样喜悦”时，额外造成5点无视护甲的伤害。死亡后数值不会清零。

点数指示器将会显示在经验值条上方。如果玩家无点数，该指示器将被隐藏。
gameSetting.enDesc:
Point cap: 100.

Ability effect: each attack consumes 1 point of "Abnormal Joy" to deal 2 points of armor-ignoring damage, up to a maximum of 5 points consumed. When 5 points of "Abnormal Joy" are consumed, it deals an additional 5 points of armor-ignoring damage. The value is not reset to zero on death.

The point indicator is displayed above the XP bar. If the player has no points, the indicator is hidden.
